descriptions.text: Tattoo. The Eye of the Bedlam Bride.

recap.text: Shi Maria, joined to Carl's body by the Golden Combo, brews ink in a beaker from a sliver of toraline root and Self-Immolation, then eats the stick she jabs into Li Jun's eye. She tells Carl in his mind that if he won't bring her card to the next floor, she will attach herself to something he can't discard, and pokes the inked stick into his chest. When he times out, the eye blinks and closes.

Rosetta pushes an ice-cold hand down Carl's shirt onto the tattoo, and he hands over a finger-sized slice of toraline and the glass container with a few thimblefuls of ink left. The eye blinks. Carl takes the Glory Bound treatment with Mordecai's Removal Order to lock Shi Maria in the dream, and Hapanzi says she is trapped. Vinata cracks his skull against the ground, then stares into the open eye and goes mad.

Eris shows Carl a five-sided coin and hands it to Uzi Jesus to flip. Carl offers to worship her if she stops, but she wants a true worshipper, and the Eye of the Bedlam Bride burns a hole in his shirt. In a dog's body, Carl opens the eye on reflex when the mimic Mitch lunges. Mitch freezes, sparkling and crying that it is too cold, until Donut's magic missile kills him.

beats.headline: Something he cannot discard
beats.text: Combined with Carl by the Golden Combo, Shi Maria has his body. She brews ink in a beaker with a sliver of toraline root and Self-Immolation, strips off his trollskin shirt and takes out the stick and poke tattoo kit. When Li Jun slides down to help, she jabs the stick into his eye and eats it. If Carl will not bring her card to the next floor, she says in his mind, she will attach herself to something he cannot discard so easily, and she pokes the inked stick into the centre of his chest, faster than possible. When he times out and is himself again, the eye blinks, and closes.
beats.gist: Shi Maria jabs an inked stick into Carl's eye, eats it, then tattoos his chest.

beats.headline: A bruise under the skin
beats.text: Carl has just said they will not keep the Golden Combo card when Donut asks what that crazy spider lady did to him. The tattoo on his chest is invisible, because the eye is closed, and it feels like a bruise. Only Li Na, Li Jun and Imani have seen it. It is not important right now, he tells her.
beats.gist: Carl's chest tattoo is invisible and feels like a bruise; he tells Donut it is not important.

beats.headline: Rosetta's cold hand
beats.text: Rosetta, newly arrived with Tipid, pushes her hand down the front of Carl's shirt and lays it on the Bedlam Bride tattoo, her fingers like ice. Then she wants the toraline, and the ink the spider used to make the tattoo. He hands over a finger-sized slice of the root and the glass container, still hot to the touch, with only a few thimblefuls of ink left, and feels the eye blink on his chest, as if her touch has woken it.
beats.gist: Rosetta puts her icy hand on Carl's tattoo, takes toraline and spider ink, and his tattoo's eye blinks.

beats.headline: Glory Bound and Removal Order
beats.text: Shi Maria grows stronger with every attempt on Carl's mind. The eye on his chest is open, blinking, looking angrily back and forth and trying to cast, and despite his Wisp Armor she has just spoken in his head. So Carl takes the Glory Bound treatment, which will carry him into the spider's worst memory, with Mordecai's Removal Order added, so that he can choose to lock her in the dream for good. The tattoo would stay on his chest, under his control. If he fails, he wakes up with a very pissed-off entity inside him.
beats.gist: Carl takes Glory Bound and Removal Order to lock Shi Maria in the dream.

beats.headline: It worked, sort of
beats.text: Carl comes round from the treatment on the other side of the map, with no idea how he got there. His treatment worked, sort of, according to Shi Maria's husband Hapanzi, who reappeared at the end of the dream to say he has her now, good and trapped. Carl can see from the eye on his chest now. It is still a tattoo, but he can feel it when it is open, and he has to make a conscious effort to keep it closed.
beats.gist: Carl wakes across the map with a tattoo eye on his chest that he can see through.

beats.headline: Trapped, says Hapanzi
beats.text: Watching the replay of the ballroom, Carl knows that at that moment, in the dream, Shi Maria vanished and her husband Hapanzi came back as a spider to tell him she is trapped in his own body. Carl now controls the eye and the containment she is in. He can summon her again, once, and then she may choose to take over his body or expel herself into her own form: one more bomb in his inventory, an especially dangerous one. She does not look nearly as trapped as Hapanzi said. The eye on his chest is clenched closed.
beats.gist: Hapanzi, as a spider, tells Carl that Shi Maria is trapped in his body.

beats.headline: Vinata stares into it
beats.text: Wrapped round Carl, Vinata crushes him, chokes him with one pair of hands, stabs at him with another, and with the upper pair slams his head against the ground by his hair until his skull cracks. You killed my people, she says. Choking and inebriated, Carl realises his shirt is open, and the eye on his chest is open with it. Vinata is staring straight into it. She has been driven mad by the Eye of the Bedlam Bride.
beats.gist: Vinata, maddened by the Eye of the Bedlam Bride, chokes and crushes Carl while staring at his chest.

beats.headline: Open for Eris
beats.text: Eris shows Carl a five-sided coin: one of its results has to happen, she says, and she hands it to Uzi Jesus to flip. Carl panics. The rushing feeling is back, all around him at once, and on his chest the long-dormant Eye of the Bedlam Bride is open, burning a hole in his shirt. He offers to worship her right now if she stops. She wants a true worshipper, she says, and tells Jesus to flip it.
beats.gist: Eris has Uzi Jesus flip a five-sided coin while Carl's Eye of the Bedlam Bride burns open.

beats.headline: On a dog's forehead
beats.text: In a dog's body, Carl remembers the tattoo only when it tries to wrench itself open: it has moved to the centre of his forehead, hidden. Let me take over, Shi Maria says. He tells her she is trapped and will stay trapped. If you say so, she answers; she is here when he needs her. Then the mimic Mitch lurches forward to consume him, Carl opens the eye on reflex, and Mitch freezes, sparkling, crying that it is too cold, until Donut's magic missile kills him.
beats.gist: In a dog's body, Carl remembers the forehead tattoo and opens its eye, freezing the mimic Mitch.
